title: ARRRGGGGHHHHH
description:
A modpack for playing as
pirates with your friends!
body:
## Summary
'ave ye ever wanted t' sail the Java seas wit' yer custom built ship, fight ferocius pirates 'n get dat plunder? If so ye're in starb'rd place. Dis modpack includes valykerian skies 'n two mods t' use it, A new wind system fer immersive sailin', special worldgeneration fer piratin', rival pirates , create 'n create big cannons fer shootin' 'n many more.
## What This Modpack Adds:
Some performance mods , some mods to improve multiplayer experience (you may wanna close incapacitated for singleplayer) , create and big cannons to well create, a special world generation to create a world consisting of seas and islands, handicaped swimming,alexs mobs/caves, guns, and the most important of them all: **valkyreian sails/eureka** to create a custom built ship. Theres also enemy pirates roaming the land.
## Can I Use This For Content?
Yep, as long as you provide a link to the project and credit me you're allowed to do whatever you want!
